title: A Bublé Christmas – Starring Cameron Taylor
description: A festive tribute night at Layton Institute – swing, jazz, pop and all the Christmas favourites, performed live by Cameron Taylor with a 3-piece band. Sunday 6th December, doors 6:30pm – show starts 7:30pm. Tickets £15, available via TicketSource or on the door.

title: Layton Lights Switch On
description: Community lights switch-on event at Layton Square. See the Layton Methodist Facebook page for full details.

title: Mum's Playin' Out: Baby-Wearing Dance
description: Join Charlie from "Dance Like a Mother" - baby in the carrier, music up, dancing like no one can see. Two left feet welcome. Babies from 8 weeks to 2 years. Part of Mum's Playin' Out - Pride in Place Layton, free events for new mums to support their mental health, sense of identity and joy. Friday 30 October, 10:30am at The Grange, Grange Park. Mum's Playin' Out on Facebook →

title: Mum's Playin' Out: Baby Friendly Comedy
description: Comedy clubs don't want your baby. We do. Daytime laughs with the fabulous comedians Black Liver & friends. No shushing. Adult content, so babies 18 months and under welcome. Part of Mum's Playin' Out - Pride in Place Layton, free events for new mums to support their mental health, sense of identity and joy. Friday 6 November, 10:30am at The Grange, Grange Park. Mum's Playin' Out on Facebook →

title: Christmas Market at Blackpool Cricket Club
description: Stalls are fully sold out! Please come along for a gorgeous festive afternoon, supporting small businesses. Plenty of gorgeous stalls, gifting, sweet treats, decorations etc. The bar is open and you could even book yourself a table for Sunday lunch! Sunday 15 November, 1pm-5pm at Blackpool Cricket Club. Free entry. Raising money for Mind. Blackpool Cricket Club on Facebook →

title: Barbie Spooky Styling Session
description: A free children’s Barbie and Ken styling and play session hosted by Vintagebarbieclare. Pick your Barbie or Ken, choose their outfit and accessories, then take photos (optional) or just play. Fancy dress optional. Everything is provided and adults are welcome to join in with their children. Friday 30 October, 10:30am-12:30pm at Layton Library. Booking essential: contact Layton Library on 01253 478145 or layton.library@blackpool.gov.uk to book your child’s place.

title: Christmas Market at Christ King Church
location: Christ King Church, 241 Bispham Road, Blackpool FY2 0LB
description: Lots of handmade gifts, unique finds and treats, with something for everyone. A great way to get a head start on your Christmas shopping while supporting local small businesses. Stalls so far include Boo Blooms, Resin by Olivia, Bling by Amy, Inner Sparkle, The Dessert Lab and more, with Mr Whippy Blackpool outside serving ice creams and waffles. Saturday 21 November 2026, 11am-3pm. Free entry.

title: The Deadbeats: Halloween Party Night
description: Live rock, pop and party classics from The Deadbeats at Layton Institute. Saturday 31 October, doors 8pm. £5 in advance or £8 on the door. Fancy dress welcome if you dare.

title: P!NK Tribute Live with Full Band: Beautiful Trauma
description: Beautiful Trauma, featuring Stacy Green as P!NK, live with a full band at Layton Institute. Friday 13 November, 8pm. £12 in advance or £16 on the door.

title: Elf Jr. The Musical
description: AVR present Elf Jr. The Musical, a festive family show full of songs, dance and Christmas magic. Sunday 20 December, 7pm at Layton Institute. Standard £12, concession (over 60 and under 16) £10.

title: AVR Dance Camp: October Half Term
description: A week of dance, performance and fun over October half term, Monday 26 to Friday 30 October, 8:30am to 3:30pm. £13 per person per day or £55 for the full week. Open to AVR students and non-AVR students, everyone welcome. Runs every half term.

title: Layton Police and Community Together (PACT)
description: Do you have any policing concerns or ideas for Layton? Come and talk to Layton police, hosted by Layton Together and Forward Project. Tuesday 1 December, 5:30pm at Layton Methodist, FY3 7DZ.

title: Monthly Afternoon Film Club: The Great Escaper
description: Layton's new monthly Afternoon Film Club launches with The Great Escaper, the moving true story of a Second World War veteran who sets off on a remarkable journey to Normandy to remember those who served. A fitting choice for Remembrance Day. Wednesday 11 November, 2pm at Layton Methodist Church, FY3 7DZ. Certificate 12A. Free admission, with tea, coffee and scones.
homeBlurb: Our first Afternoon Film Club shows The Great Escaper, the moving true story of a Second World War veteran's journey to Normandy to remember those who served. A fitting choice for Remembrance Day. Free admission, with tea, coffee and scones. Everyone welcome.
